name: armamentarium
description: Public half of the owner's Claude Code armamentarium: reasoning and verification skills that carry no personal data and work in any repository

plugins.name: think
plugins.description: Structured reasoning through the ADI cycle (abduction, deduction, induction, audit, decide) for decisions with more than one plausible answer

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: Verify a finished result against a standard using a fresh sub-agent with context isolation, so it judges the artifact rather than the reasoning that produced it
